full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for disposal of this Rule, in short, are that the petitioners, as plaintiffs, filed Other Class Suit No. 206 of 1998 in the court of learned Senior Assistant Judge, Ishwardi, against the present opposite parties, as defendant, for a declaration of title contending inter alia, that the schedule-'Ka' property under DS Khatian No. 1237 originally belonged to Mofizuddin Sarder and others. The property was sold in auction in Certificate Case No. 237 of 1943. One Rahmat Ali Sarder purchased the same in auction from whom predecessor of plaintiffs named Rezia Khatun purchased the suit property by registered deed dated 20-3-1944. Property under DS Khatian No. 1364 originally belonged to one Jonaki Nath Paul under whom one Bolai Sarder was borgader, subsequently Jonaki Nath Paul evicted his borgader Bolai Sarder and took the property in his khas possession and sold out the same to Rezia Khatun by registered deed dated 5-5-1945. Rezia Khatun after purchase erected house on a portion of land and was residing therein with her sons and on a part of suit property planted different types of trees and was enjoying the property with the knowledge of all. The defendants have had no title and possession in the suit property.
